Divisional Operations Leader and Chief of Staff for SVP overseeing a $4.1B P/L with 1000+ associates across 12 Medicare Advantage states and Puerto Rico.  Accountable for supporting all state operations teams to achieve membership growth targets, P/L pre-tax targets, and cost savings strategies.   Worked with the Divisional CFO on budget and regional performance management metrics (revenue/pre-tax/membership/network discounts/cost of care targets, etc.)

As Senior Advisor between SVP and staff:  Led strategic planning offsites, drove prioritization and program management of full portfolio of divisional initiatives, created Board/C-Suite/SVP presentations, led preparation and had seat at the table for quarterly Business Operating Reviews with President of Medicare and state Presidents. 

Instrumental in CMS bid development and go-to-market strategy working closely with sales, network, product, actuary, marketing, IT, digital, service, clinical, and state-based market operations teams.  

Part of the team that opened up Humana’s Northeast Region (NY, ME, and NH).  Member of ground floor start-up team for new product offerings, build of captive agent infrastructure and marketing plans for New York City and all surrounding boroughs with a 3-year revenue of $500M.   Led "Operations Committee" designed to react and correct end-to-end start-up issues in a SWAT team format.  

Expertise in Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) strategy and the transformative opportunity to 
leverage technology and In-Home Care to connect the ecosystem necessary to drive Whole Health

experience.title: Corporate Director, $5.1B Humana Pharmacy PBM Operations
experience.summary:
Developed 6-Sigma based strategic planning and innovation process and led several major initiatives with the goal of doubling the $5B Mail Order business.  

Generated revenue lift from improvements to provider engagement and outbound calling operations.

experience.title: Director, Innovation and JV Start-up Operations (Humana Vitality / Go365 JV)
experience.summary:
Part of start-up team that created an 8M member JV business plan sold to C-Suite.  

As one of the first 10 employees, involved with the build out of operations, product innovation process, website, and consumer experience model for a national health/wellbeing rewards company.

Enabled an 85% growth in membership by driving IT requirements and implementation of “Stand Alone” program.

Supported development of the Walmart “Healthy Foods” program resulting in a 17% growth in consumer engagement.

experience.title: Enterprise Director, Provider Network and Site of Care Transparency
experience.summary:
Full ownership of $18M budget and development of the acclaimed “MyChoice” online transparency tool allowing 11M consumers to compare cost, quality, member experience of physicians, hospitals, diagnostics and pharmacies 
	
Generated $248M in run rate cost savings via lower cost and higher quality referrals made to preferred providers

Led pilot launch with Chrysler, Raytheon, and Marsh McLennan resulting in the retention of a coalition of 1000+ companies and a successful national launch

Received national recognition from Mercer Consulting as the best-in-class, innovative web tool from among the top 5 national health insurers.

experience.title: Senior Director, Product Innovation and Integrated Consumer Experience
experience.summary:
Part of the product innovation/strategy team that built Humana’s first High Deductible Health Plans (HDHPs), as well as first Health Savings Account (HSA), and involved with internal/external implementations

Working with the Chief Consumer Officer (CCO), led market research and national pilot launch for first-to-market “SmartSummary” member communication resulting in engagement and self-service rising by 14%

Created and drove partnership with Steve Case (AOL founder), with his start-up “Revolution Health,” resulting in a General Agency agreement with the potential for 250k new members

experience.title: Vice President, Operational Excellence Services (Internal Consulting Practice)
experience.summary:
Vice President and one of the founding partners that built Fidelity's internal process consulting practice.  Lead executive relationship owner for the $4.1T AUM Brokerage Company (10K employees).

Involvement with the practice build-out included: 
-	Development of the 6 Sigma methodology and consulting models	  
-      Change management and internal communications
-	Project portfolio management/prioritization           
-      Executive relationships and resource allocations
-	Multi-year strategic planning process
-      Coordination of Cross-Business initiatives

Built and led teams of 75+ professionals across strategy, operating-model design, change management, and Lean / Six Sigma deployments.

Operational Excellence Lead VP for the “New Account” process, resulting in $35.4M in cost reductions, quality and call center service level improvements, and $11.7M in self-service, customer service, and productivity savings.  

Operational Excellence Lead VP for the Corporate “Transfer of Assets” business area, resulting in $14.8M in cost reductions and productivity gains and was subsequently applied to an $11B customer group, resulting in $70M in new revenue.  

Achieved $32.1M in cost reduction via process improvements and applying the “Toyota Production System” to implement data-based decisions and improve quality and capacity of national outbound print operations.
